Name: NPC Eugene(SVE patch)
Author: muxuelaiyin
Description:
只包含修改文件，没有经过全面测试，如果有加载性的问题，请向我报告。
安装方式为：下载原Mod和此Mod，用此Mod中的文件替换原Mod文件。
对于非韩语玩家，需要手动更换下data/EugeneMapData中的翻译文本。

我做了什么：
重绘了SVE版本的地图，修改传送点和行程中的坐标。

感谢原作者和SVE作者同意制作兼容版本并上传，一切版权与荣誉归功于她们。

这是原Mod的链接：[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7002?tab=description]Custom NPC Eugene[/url]。

PS：更改后的尤金与SVE版的NPC Aymeric不兼容（森林太过拥挤），或许等我有空一些时会为他做另一版兼容，如果你想自己动手，欢迎。

————————————————————————————————————————————————————————
It only includes modifying files and has not undergone comprehensive testing. If there are any loading issues, please report them to me.
The installation method is to download the original Mod and this Mod, and replace the original Mod file with the file in this Mod.
For non Korean players, it is necessary to manually replace the translated text in the data/EugeneMapData.

Thank you to the original author and SVE author for agreeing to create a compatible version and upload it. All copyrights and honors are attributed to them.

This is the link to the original mod:[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7002?tab=description]Custom NPC Eugene[/url].

PS: The modified Eugene is not compatible with the SVE version of NPC Aymeric (the forest is too crowded). Perhaps I will make another version compatible for him when I have some free time. If you want to do it yourself, welcome.
